newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig still a Fator buy. [CORRECTED 19:52 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig still a Fator buy. [CORRECTED 19:52 GMT]

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it maintained its buy rating on Minas Gerais state telecom Telemig.
-- Analysts Sidney Chameh and Sergio Missima said the firm posted enexpectedly good first half results mainly due to a rise in rates at the end of 1995 coupled with lower administrative costs.
-- They raised their net income forecast for 1996 to 273 million reais.

-- They also said the firm has a favourable outlook due to higher demand for cellular phones, which is expected to rise (corrects from plunge) to 490,000 terminals by the end of 1997 from the current 280,000.
-- Telemig common shares (corrects from preferred shares) fell to 89.99 reais, down 2.01 percent.
